scope_note: Corrective DET01 evidence audit. Official parcel, permit, tax, water-account, state-certificate, EPA and operator records are retained as direct observations or clearly labeled source forecasts. Conflicting floor-area figures remain separate because their reporting definitions differ. Construction cost, realized jobs, supplier payments, community funding, electricity, emissions, wastewater, actual public-service cost and causal county effects remain unbounded rather than being filled with transferred assumptions.

project_updates.title: Operator reports and dimensions search
project_updates.notes: Source family: EdgeConneX operator reports. Exact queries: DET01, Detroit Data Sheet, 21005 Lahser; inspected the July 28, 2014 launch release and 2024 and March 2026 data sheets. Useful result: existing DET01 is reported at 39,900 square feet and 3 MW N+1, with 9,930 square feet raised floor in 2026; the potential 7 MW second building is excluded. project_updates.project_description: EdgeConneX DET01 is a 39,900-square-foot colocation data center in Southfield, Michigan, created by remodeling a vacant commercial shell in 2014 and documented as operating by March 11, 2015. The account separates the original conversion from a potential second building and follows the existing facility's real property, industrial-facilities-tax period, post-expiration personal property, and rated power.

project_updates.title: Identity and chronology search
project_updates.notes: Source families: operator releases, City parcel/permit records and City ACFRs; exact identifiers 21005 Lahser Road, parcel 76-24-33-476-055, PB14-0532, JALC14-0126, EdgeConneX and Cybernetix; inspected 2011-2026 history. Useful result: July 28, 2014 sale, June 26, 2014 permit application, August 15 issuance, January 21, 2015 final and operation no later than March 11, 2015. project_updates.title: County economic-input and causal-design audit
project_updates.notes: Source family: repository-governed official BEA/BLS county panel; exact geography Oakland County FIPS 26125 and comparison pool, 2001-2024 employment, earnings and unemployment inputs; inspected pre/post series and prior mechanical matching outputs. Useful result: county context remains available. Negative result: no registered causal design, exact treatment isolation, exposure-screened controls, contamination audit, placebo tests or robust post-period identification; all three descriptive comparison estimates were removed rather than labeled as DET01 effects.
